articles.title: ONC cuts health IT certification criteria in HTI​‑5 final rule
articles.summary_4_sentences: ONC finalized the HTI-5 rule with changes that reduce the number of health IT certification criteria. The rule cuts 14 criteria and revises seven others to make certification easier to achieve. It also delays decisions on information blocking, leaving some policy questions unresolved. The update signals a deregulatory shift in federal health IT oversight while preserving the broader certification framework.

articles.title: HTI-5 offers drawbacks and transitions - here's what stakeholders think
articles.summary_4_sentences: Healthcare stakeholders are reacting to the newly finalized HTI-5 health IT certification rule. The article highlights both perceived benefits and drawbacks, especially around reduced regulatory burden for developers and users. It also points ahead to HTI-6, which is expected to continue the policy debate soon. Together, the reactions suggest the rule will reshape compliance planning across the health IT market.

articles.title: Prior authorization in the real world: Takeaways from Epic ahead of looming API deadline

The article frames the deadline as a major near-term test for electronic prior authorization adoption.

articles.title: Amazon, Google, Oracle pledge support for prior authorization reforms
articles.summary_4_sentences: Amazon, Google and Oracle pledged technical support for prior authorization reforms tied to self-funded plans. The move expands on the government's earlier Prior Authorization Pledge. The companies said they will make technical improvements intended to streamline the process. The announcement underscores growing big-tech involvement in administrative health IT modernization.

articles.title: 5 major companies pledge faster, electronic prior authorizations

The commitment covers plans serving millions of Americans. The article presents the pledge as an employer-led effort to reduce friction in coverage decisions. It adds momentum to broader industry pressure for electronic prior authorization workflows.
